notes.v1_10: Handcuffs: Paint the steel a slightly deeper cool grey in soft satin, with one crisp bright highlight along the top of each ring and darker cool blue-grey on the inner curves and under the lock boxes, so the cuffs read clearly darker than the floor. Add a slightly darker, firmer contact shadow under both cuffs and a soft lighter glow on the coral floor just behind them. Keep the cuffs, the chain, the locks, the keyholes, the pink floor and the view.
notes.v1_03: Magnifier: Tint the lens glass a pale, clear cool blue-grey in place of the background green, with one soft curved reflection along its upper left. Make the right side of the metal ring and the underside of the red handle slightly darker, and add a soft faint shadow of the magnifier on the rings. Keep the magnifier, the green ring backdrop and the view.
